company.name: UvU Shuttle
company.shortDescription: UvU is a tech-enabled shuttle bus for intra & inter-city rides
company.description:
UvU is a passenger transportation software for schools, organizations, airports and governments.

Besides the software solution (client & driver apps, dispatch system) which allows to effectively manage thousands of vehicles, UvU’s value includes:
1. Long-term contracts with organisations (corporations, shopping malls, travel agencies, schools, government entities and etc) with the access to parking and promotion activities
2. Intracity transportation infrastructure: special bus-stops, bus-lanes, 
3. Investment infrastructure for private individuals (including passengers)/organisations to invest into buses having good and safe returns

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $800,000, or 70.73% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,635,577 to $10,000,000, a 2.75x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 85 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
